derivation.reason: Conservative format ceiling times all planned rows; NOT predicted actual bytes or a fit claim. Order<2^16,p<2^17; job/curve/target IDs bounded; all failures/caps remain included. Rejection sampling can hit declared guards.

physical_policy.method: One unmodified full engine call. Kernel per-file/address-space limits plus polling tree/log/free-space/watchdog guards. No local archive or compressed duplicate is created.
physical_policy.current_machine_fit: No unconditional worst-case completion claim. Future admission must account configured hard per-file/tree/document/memory limits, free-byte reserve, other concurrent runs and root publication/readback. Any guard leaves unknown/incomplete data.
physical_policy.polling_qualification: Tree/free-space guards are monitored every10ms; not filesystem quotas or a hard bound on scheduler latency. Kernel per-file limits and native address-space guard remain. Parent preserves all bytes available after wait.
physical_policy.log_rule: Reader pauses on limit crossing until process group is terminated and reaped, then drains remaining bounded pipe bytes. No emitted bytes are deliberately dropped.
physical_policy.parent_documents: Bounded streaming JSON writer saves a prefix on an actual document-byte refusal; original output remains incomplete, never synthetically complete.
physical_policy.hard_upper_formula: 7*file_bytes +25*document_bytes +input_bytes +generation_bytes +4*(log_bytes+65536+observed_pipe_capacity); configured caps, not an observed total. This loose hard sum may exceed current disk; it never establishes fit.
physical_policy.native_extra_copies: Later native/archive/publication contract must count any copies. Supported no-local-duplicate route is root-authorized original-file upload plus uncached full GET STREAM SHA/byte verification; stream_payload uses at most declared chunk size and leaves raw originals untouched.
physical_policy.deletion: No raw spool retirement, remote write or credential use in v4.

historical_qualification: Actual old completion record only; no future bound, compression/RSS ratio or time estimate.
remaining_qualification: First actual fresh full-cohort execution and complete output counts are not performed in this source stage.
Future admission must supply sufficient declared resources or preserve a truthful resource stop.
No qualified total attack cost, native primitive replay, isolated clocks or peak RSS claim.
